decisions.reason: Heine–Borel supplies metric compactness. The omitted agreement theorem has exactly the same open-cover condition for the Euclidean subspace topology, so this is a nonfatal dependency/citation omission, not a false compactness claim. Added thm-compactness-agrees-with-metric-compactness to deps and F1, cited both results in step 2.1, and synchronized the owning manifest and exact proof contract. Polynomial closedness, bounded entries, adjoint inverses, and continuity establish the remaining claims without Choice.

The rejection overlooks the declared def-dimension interface: its Definition explicitly defines dim V only when V has a finite basis and says no number is attached to an infinite-dimensional space. Thus dim R >= dim H quantifies over finite-dimensional auxiliaries in this library; it does not assert an infinite-dimensional partial trace. On that domain, XX*=rho and YY*=sigma, the rectangular SVD gives contraction factors W,V, and trace duality bounds |tr(A*WV*)|. The displayed J and attaining square unitary C give both correct marginals and equality for every admissible R, including singular states. No edit is needed.

The Statement claims only a CPTP construction attaining target expectation N_n/N_m, exactly as proved. Both summands have the displayed Kraus operators; the partial-traced Haar moment restores the symmetric input trace and tr(EX)omega restores its complement on every operator. Symmetric pure tensors eliminate the correction and give the asserted expectation, including m=n and d=1. The separate lem-qc-optimal-cloning-worst-case-upper-bound proves the competing-channel bound, and thm-qc-optimal-universal-pure-state-cloning-bound combines the two. The title does not create an additional optimality premise or a circular dependency.
